title: Cheesecake
hookLine: Silky whipped custard meets crisp crust—creamy, jiggly, and 100% crowd-approved.

items.name: Crushed graham crackers or digestive biscuits

steps.title: Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out {eu38_cc}, {eu38_sug}, {eu38_eggs}, and {eu38_sour} and {eu38_flv}, {eu38_crumb}, and {eu38_but} in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

steps.title: Press Crust & Beat Cream Cheese Silky
steps.instructionTemplate: Press {eu38_crumb} with {eu38_but} into a parchment-lined springform pan. Beat {eu38_cc} and {eu38_sug} 2 mins until satin smooth.
steps.creatorSecret: Always use room-temp cream cheese so you never have to over-whip (which causes cracks).

steps.title: Add Eggs, Cream & Bake Slowly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold in {eu38_eggs}, {eu38_sour}, and {eu38_flv}. Bake at 325°F (165°C) for 45 mins until edges set and center gently wobbles. Plate into 8 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.criticalTip: Chill at least 4 hours in the fridge before slicing with a warm wiped knife.
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

steps.title: Remove from Heat, Cool & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Pull the pan off the heat as soon as Cheesecake coats the spoon thickly. Let cool slightly so the glaze or custard thickens even more, then spoon into 8 bowls and garnish before serving.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
